# The release index (Milestone 162, docs/design/install-cache.md): every published hydo release's
# archives by sha256, and the guest kernels and initramfs files inside them. It is compiled into
# hydo (hydo-image, src/releases.rs), so every hydo can fetch an earlier release's archive with a
# pinned sha256 and find the release that shipped a kernel an image names.
#
# Additions only: a line of a published release never changes. After publishing a release, add
# its two archive lines (the sha256 of the release's SHA256SUMS asset) and its file lines
# (docs/RELEASING.md, "Publish"). The running hydo's own version is known without lines here.
#
#   archive <version> <platform> <sha256> <archive file name>
#   file    <version> <platform> <sha256> <path below the archive's top directory>
